_comment: Strata Stone weathering. Level 0 is the clean font; levels 1..N are built as 'Strata Stone Worn N'. chips: share of edge pixels knocked out; bumps: share of outward bumps; fault: sideways shift (px) of the upper part along a fault line, 0 = off. Damage is progressive: everything at level N is also at level N+1. alternates: variants per glyph, cycled by the calt feature.
